repos_data.description: Modern networking and security platform providing secure access and connectivity to apps, infrastructure, and AI workloads. Connect and protect your users.

Use your phone's Face ID or fingerprint to approve sudo and unlock your Mac. QR pairing, encrypted BLE, Secure Enclave signing — keys never leave your phone. Works with iPhone, Android, Apple Watch, Wear OS, or any browser. No $199 Magic Keyboard needed.
